hero.title: Welcome To
hero.subtitle: Your Trusted Partner in Property Management and Serviced Apartments

introduction.title: About Us
introduction.content: Global Al Saida United LLC, known by the trade name Nassayem Salalah, was established in 2022 to be a strong pillar in enhancing the local economy in Dhofar and to be among the leading companies in real estate development. Nassayem Salalah boasts extensive experience in furnished apartment rentals and real estate development, offering innovative solutions that meet the needs of both individuals and investors. The company takes pride in contributing to society by providing job opportunities for a number of citizens while committing to providing a decent and stimulating work environment for all. Nassayem Salalah currently owns and manages more than 300 residential units and villas spread across strategic locations in Dhofar, with future expansion plans to cover more promising cities and regions.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To create a new and ideal image in the world of serviced apartments and to become the leading real estate development company in Dhofar.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Providing a distinguished stay experience built on quality, comfort, and a strategic location, while remaining committed to authentic Omani and Arab hospitality.

quality.title: Quality
quality.content: To maintain the highest standards of quality in cleanliness, construction, and design.

customerSatisfaction.title: Customer Satisfaction
customerSatisfaction.content: To provide smooth and exceptional experiences that meet and exceed customer expectations.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.content: To consistently exceed expectations and set an example for others to follow.

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.content: To take full responsibility for our actions, decisions, and contributions to society.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.content: To achieve mutual benefit for us and everyone we deal with.

expansion.title: Future Expansion Plans
expansion.content: At Nassayem Salalah, we believe that sustainable growth is the key to success. After establishing more than 300 residential units in strategic locations in Dhofar Governorate, we are currently working on implementing an expansion plan that includes:
points: Opening new branches in multiple states and regions in the Sultanate and Arab Gulf countries.
Plan to add more than 200 new units in the next two years, including apartments, hotel rooms, and family villas.
Launching an electronic booking platform to facilitate access to our services from inside and outside the Sultanate.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Nassayem Salalah?
whyUs.content: At Nassayem Salalah, we believe that hospitality is not merely a stay — it's an experience crafted with care and detail. We stand out with elegant designs, prime locations, and hotel services inspired by the warmth of authentic Omani and Arab hospitality. We deliver comfort that goes beyond expectations, striving always to be the first choice for accommodation in Dhofar.
